security_spec.violation_condition: XiangShan RTL implements the mseccfg CSR (CSR address 0x747) and allows read/write access when the hart only supports Sm extension but none of Zkr, Smmpm, or Zicfilp are enabled. The CSR decoder or CSR access module fails to gate mseccfg existence on the disjunction of {Zkr, Smmpm, Zicfilp}, exposing a CSR that the spec now requires to be absent—reads return zero instead of trapping with illegal instruction, and writes do not trap as required.
security_spec.summary: mseccfg/mseccfgh must only exist when Zkr, Smmpm, or Zicfilp is implemented; unconditional CSR presence when only Sm is enabled causes illegal access to succeed where spec mandates trap

findings.finding: The mseccfg CSR module is unconditionally instantiated without any extension gating. Per norm:mseccfg_presence, mseccfg 'exists if any extension that adds a field to mseccfg is implemented. Otherwise, it is reserved.' When none of {Smepmp, Zkr, Smmpm, Zicfilp} are configured, accesses to 0x747 should trap with illegal instruction. Instead, reads return zero (and writes are silently ignored as RO), exposing a CSR that the spec requires to be absent. No HasZkr/HasSmepmp/HasSmmpm/HasZicfilp configuration parameters exist anywhere in the codebase to gate this.
findings.snippet:
val mseccfg = Module(new CSRModule("Mseccfg", new CSRBundle {
    val PMM   = EnvPMM(33, 32, wNoEffect).withReset(EnvPMM.Disable)
    val MLPE  = RO(10)
    val SSEED = RO( 9)
    val USEED = RO( 8)
    val RLB   = RO( 2)
    val MMWP  = RO( 1)
    val MML   = RO( 0)
  })).setAddr(CSRs.mseccfg)

spec_citations.excerpt: [#norm:mseccfg_presence]#It exists if any extension that adds a field to `mseccfg` is implemented. Otherwise, it is reserved.#

findings.finding: mseccfg is unconditionally added to machineLevelCSRMods, which feeds into machineLevelCSRMap and subsequently csrRwMap. Since csrRwMap is the source of truth for CSR existence in the noCSRIllegal check (NewCSR.scala:1021), mseccfg always passes the existence test and never triggers an illegal-instruction exception, even when the qualifying extensions (Smepmp, Zkr, Smmpm, Zicfilp) are absent.

spec_citations.excerpt: [#norm:mseccfg_presence]#It exists if any extension that adds a field to `mseccfg` is implemented. Otherwise, it is reserved.#

findings.finding: The mseccfg CSR address (0x747) is unconditionally included in the 'all' CSR array, which is used by the decoder stage for CSR address validation. If the decoder uses this array to check for CSR existence, it would incorrectly indicate that mseccfg is a valid CSR even when none of the qualifying extensions are implemented. Note: XiangShan's decoder may use a separate mechanism — the primary existence gate is the csrRwMap in NewCSR.scala.

spec_citations.excerpt: [#norm:mseccfg_presence]#It exists if any extension that adds a field to `mseccfg` is implemented. Otherwise, it is reserved.#

findings.finding: All mseccfg fields correctly use RO (read-only) type when the corresponding extension features are not dynamically configurable as writable. The PMM field correctly uses the EnvPMM WARL enum (Disable/PMLEN7/PMLEN16). The bit positions match spec: MML=0, MMWP=1, RLB=2, USEED=8, SSEED=9, MLPE=10, PMM=[33:32]. If the qualifying extensions were separately gated, per-field writability could be further refined, but the RO default is safe.

    val SSEED = RO( 9)
    val USEED = RO( 8)
